sentences.en: Have a cup of milk. It will do you good.
sentences.zh: 喝杯牛奶吧。这对你的身体有好处。

sentences.en: Milk can be made into butter, cheese, and many other things.
sentences.zh: 牛奶可以制成黄油、奶酪等很多东西。

sentences.en: Milk will do you good. You'd better drink it every day.
sentences.zh: 牛奶对你的身体有好处。你最好每天喝一杯。
